summary:
w99 (migration-tools r30, r31): both scenarios are red only because step definitions are missing. The code already refuses a version file that holds no version, but quotes the held text 'next' with single quotes (repr), where the accepted scenarios read "next".
D1: no_version names the held text in double quotes, as the scenarios read. The feature's precedent: the step behind 'it prints the pending upgrade step ... "work-items named by ids"' asserts double quotes literally.
D2: the steps assert the whole sentence plus exit codes; 'no file changed' means a clean git status, the same commit count and the version file unchanged.
D3: the new steps go in a new module, tests/scenarios/migration_version_steps.py (migration_upgrade_steps.py has 26 lines of room), imported by test_migration_tools.py.
No test breaks: tests/scripts/test_migrate_upgrade.py asserts substrings only (checked).
Open: how special characters in the held text are quoted, the dotted-short value 0.24, and the order of the version and dirty-tree refusals.
